messages:
alex: Heads-up — BridgeYard hitting 5xxs on dedicated pool for /generate. CS flagged a P1, error rate ~6% over the last 10m. Need owners + immediate mitigation plan.

maria: on it. I can own the platform-side triage. Can you paste sample request ids and any recent deploys?

alex: recent deploy at 1753200000. sample request ids: r:ab12, r:cd34. quick logs snippet: ```ERROR runtime: kv cache overflow at shard 7 seq=1024
stack: runtime/kv.go:211```

raj: I suspect a kv-shard off-by-one causing cache eviction loop. I can own runtime fix. ETA for WIP PR ~2h.

sophia: Oncall here — I can push a traffic policy to route BridgeYard to the lower-batch profile and fallback model in ~20m to reduce pressure. That should lower 5xxs while raj works on the fix. Need confirmation to proceed.

maria: +1 for routing change. I'll coordinate CS comms and inform customer of mitigation ETA.

raj: WIP branch runtime/kv-shard-fix created. Will run unit + integration, then open PR. If we need a hotpatch quicker I can cherry-pick.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by sophia for route-adjustment (canary). id: deploy-7765. status: pending approval.

sophia: kicking canary now, will watch p50/p95/p99 and error-rate. @alex please ping if you want an immediate rollback instead. :eyes:

alex: holding off rollback for now — want to see canary effect. Also posting infra PR for the config change that raj's fix depends on: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412

maria: reviewing infra PR now, leaving one comment about config key naming.

raj: runtime PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/998 (WIP). CI passing on unit tests, running smoke. If green I'll request merge and canary deploy.

sophia: canary route adjustment is live. BridgeYard error-rate down to 0.7% on canary subset. Holding for 30m of stable metrics before wider rollout.

cs: Thanks team — I've updated the customer with mitigation timeline and owners (maria, raj, sophia). They asked for ETA for full fix, shared your 2h estimate.

alex: great. follow-ups: 1) maria to confirm infra rename comment addressed 2) raj to merge + canary for runtime fix 3) sophia to widen rollout if metrics stable. I'll close loop after 1h or when stable. :thumbsup:
